source_candidate.exact_claim_under_test: Whether a useful-outcome entrypoint is obligatorily mediated by get_llm_provider or has a provider-free bypass.

primary_verification.mechanical_location_scope: A repository code search for get_llm_provider consumers was used only to select one entrypoint. Search snippets from unselected files were quarantined from semantic conclusions.
primary_verification.exact_checked_scope: Exactly backend/app/api/routes/chat.py at the pinned commit. No other consumer body, dependency manifest, runtime execution, issue, diff semantics, frontend, deployment environment, secret, billing/quota page, or second candidate was inspected.
primary_verification.tested_scope: The /send chat API entrypoint only; whether that exact entrypoint can produce its chat useful outcome without a successful factory-mediated provider selection.
evidence_summary: ChatRequest.provider defaults to the literal string 'groq'.
The /send handler calls get_llm_provider(req.provider) before branching into either streaming or non-streaming execution.
The handler immediately calls the returned provider's get_available_models() and derives/falls back to provider-specific model selection before useful chat execution proceeds.
For stream=true, the useful response is emitted directly from llm.stream_chat(...), so the route is explicitly provider-mediated.

For stream=false, the handler still requires get_llm_provider(req.provider) to succeed before calling agent_service.run(...); therefore an unregistered/provider-free provider name cannot bypass the factory at this entrypoint.
This same file also contains other endpoints with separate external-provider dependencies, but they were not used to broaden the tested claim.
gaps_or_contradictions: No contradiction was found with p1-sa-410 for this exact /send entrypoint.
This slice establishes that /send is obligatorily factory-mediated at route entry; it does not prove that every useful-outcome entrypoint in the repository uses this factory.
The non-stream branch may contain additional provider behavior inside agent_service.run, which was not inspected because that would be a second consumer body.
Groq quota, billing, free-tier, and cost properties remain unverified and cannot satisfy the zero-finite-quota/zero-cost acceptance gate from this slice.
primary_verification.claim_limits: Accept this pinned route as direct primary evidence that the /send chat entrypoint cannot reach either its streaming or non-streaming useful outcome without first successfully resolving req.provider through get_llm_provider. Combined with the separately recorded p1-sa-409/p1-sa-410 factory/default evidence, this exact route has no observed provider-free bypass. Do not infer candidate-global routing completeness, agent_service internals, deployment overrides, or quota/cost properties.
primary_verification.downstream_effect: The candidate-global uncertainty is reduced by one concrete useful-outcome entrypoint: /send is not a provider-free escape hatch. The candidate remains non-accepted because other entrypoints/bypasses and quota/cost gates remain unresolved. No CLEAN worker state or feedback was changed.
